combinations.description: At least 4 new key-value combinations of the failed test, each different from the others.

items.description: One value for every key dimension of the test, and for no other dimension.

dimension.description: A key dimension of the test.

label.description: The value's short name, different from the label of every other value of its dimension, in lowercase words joined by underscores.

text.description: The text that the turns insert for the dimension, different from the text of every other value of its dimension.
